# Radoslav Radev Reports That He Held Straddle Planche For More Than 25 Seconds But Was Told Seven Seconds Or Five Seconds Clean Was Enough For Full Planche

Radoslav Radev reports that he achieved straddle planche and held it for more than 25 seconds. [src: vid-aXwZ_WI1vSw @ 04:35] Victor Kamenov told him he only needed seven seconds or five seconds clean straddle planche to be ready for full planche. [src: vid-aXwZ_WI1vSw @ 04:45]

## Details

- He held the straddle planche more than 25 seconds and thought he would need more time and more hold to go from straddle to full. [src: vid-aXwZ_WI1vSw @ 04:35]
- He wrote a message to Victor Kamenov, who told him he actually needed seven seconds or five seconds clean straddle planche and was ready for the full planche. [src: vid-aXwZ_WI1vSw @ 04:45]
- He says the straddle planche will not teach you on full planche, the tuck planche will not teach you on advanced tuck, and the advanced tuck will not teach you on the straddle planche. [src: vid-aXwZ_WI1vSw @ 04:55]

## Evidence

- vid-aXwZ_WI1vSw @ 04:35 (Radoslav Radev): "i achieved straddle planche and i held the straddle planche more than 25 seconds and i thought i will need more time to go from straddle to full i will need more hold"
- vid-aXwZ_WI1vSw @ 04:45 (Radoslav Radev): "but actually i wrote message to victor kamenov and he told me how actually i have i need seven seconds or five seconds clean straddle planche and i'm ready for the full planche"
- vid-aXwZ_WI1vSw @ 04:55 (Radoslav Radev): "the straddle planche will not teach me on full planche the tuck planche will not teach you on advanced tuck the advanced tuck will not teach you on the straddle planche so if you stay too much time on the current progression that's bad and you will lose time"

## Example From The Source

Radoslav himself held straddle planche for more than 25 seconds, thought he needed more. [src: vid-aXwZ_WI1vSw @ 04:35] He was told by Victor Kamenov that seven seconds or five seconds clean was enough and he was ready for full planche. [src: vid-aXwZ_WI1vSw @ 04:45]
